<<<POU name=AerationBlower kind=function_block>>>
FUNCTION_BLOCK AerationBlower
VAR_INPUT
    DO_LOW : BOOL;
    AERATION_E_STOP_NC : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    BLOWER_RUN : BOOL;
    AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT : UINT;
END_VAR
VAR
    startTon : TON;
    runTrig : R_TRIG;
END_VAR
<<<IMPL>>>
startTon(IN := DO_LOW AND AERATION_E_STOP_NC, PT := T#5s);
BLOWER_RUN := startTon.Q;
runTrig(CLK := BLOWER_RUN);
IF runTrig.Q THEN
    AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT := AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT + 1;
END_IF
<<<END>>>
